en_title: Rockstar Publishes Full GTA 6 Credits — But Beware, They Contain Major Spoilers
cn_title: Rockstar公布《GTA6》完整制作人员名单——但要注意，其中包含重大剧透
opus_summary: 《GTA6》在全球发售后，Rockstar在线公布了游戏完整制作人员名单，其中包含重大剧透。名单列出数千名开发者及数十名演员，原文估计共有约6000个名字。去年被Rockstar解雇的34名员工均获得署名，但名单中没有联合创始人Dan Houser。

paragraphs.en: With GTA 6 now launched across the world, Rockstar has published the game's full credits online — with some major spoilers hidden in plain view.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》现已在全球发售，Rockstar在线公布了游戏的完整制作人员名单——其中一些重大剧透就藏在显眼处。

paragraphs.en: Thousands of developers are named on Rockstar's GTA 6 credits page , which also includes a list of the dozens of cast members who portray characters in the game. We reckon around 6,000 names are on the list.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar的《GTA6》制作人员名单页面列出了数千名开发人员，也列出了在游戏中饰演角色的数十名演员。我们估计名单上约有6000个名字。

paragraphs.en: As revealed earlier this week when her Game Awards nomination was announced, Manni L. Perez is the actress behind main character Lucia Caminos . And as confirmed today via our first photo of the game's stars together in real life , Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason Duval is played by actor Dylan Rourke.
paragraphs.cn: 正如本周早些时候公布The Game Awards提名时所揭晓的，Manni L. Perez是主角Lucia Caminos的饰演者。而今天，我们通过游戏主演在现实中同框的首张照片确认，Lucia的犯罪搭档Jason Duval由演员Dylan Rourke饰演。

paragraphs.en: Other major characters include Donnie played by True Detective's Brad Carter, Cal played by former Saturday Night Live cast member Bobby Moynihan, Brian Heder played by King of the Hill voice actor Stephen Root, Lori Heder played by prolific voice actress Orlagh Cassidy and Kenton Rees played by Trinidadian singer and songwriter Machel Montano.
paragraphs.cn: 其他主要角色包括由《真探》演员布拉德·卡特饰演的Donnie、由《周六夜现场》前演员鲍比·莫尼汉饰演的Cal、由《一家之主》配音演员斯蒂芬·鲁特饰演的Brian Heder、由作品众多的配音演员Orlagh Cassidy饰演的Lori Heder，以及由特立尼达歌手兼词曲作者Machel Montano饰演的Kenton Rees。

paragraphs.en: Scroll further down the cast list and players will likely spot something that we're going to absolutely label as a spoiler — it's your choice whether you want to read more right now.
paragraphs.cn: 继续向下浏览演员名单，玩家很可能会发现一些我们绝对会视为剧透的内容——是否现在继续阅读由你自己决定。

paragraphs.en: Celebrity names in the cast list include a string of celebrity radio hosts, including "Weird Al" Yankovic as DJ Al, Brigitte Nielsen as Madame Brigitte, Puerto Rican rapper and Super Bowl LX halftime show star Bad Bunny as El Martillo, British acting legend Jeremy Irons as DJ Dicky, Gloria and Emilio Estefan as themselves, The Big Bang Theory's Brian Posehn as Big Fan Brian, and the legendary Keith Richards as DJ Keith.
paragraphs.cn: 演员名单上的名人包括一系列名人电台主持人，其中包括饰演DJ Al的「怪人奥尔」扬科维奇、饰演Madame Brigitte的碧姬·尼尔森、饰演El Martillo的波多黎各说唱歌手兼第六十届超级碗中场秀明星Bad Bunny、饰演DJ Dicky的英国传奇演员杰瑞米·艾恩斯、饰演自己的Gloria Estefan和Emilio Estefan、饰演Big Fan Brian的《生活大爆炸》演员布莱恩·波塞恩，以及饰演DJ Keith的传奇人物基思·理查兹。

paragraphs.en: Development-wise, as you'd expect, Rockstar Games founder and executive producer Sam Houser leads the credits list, alongside head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe, plus co-studio heads Rob Nelson and Aaron Garbut. If you're searching for them, the 34 staff fired by Rockstar last year in controversial circumstances are all credited.
paragraphs.cn: 在开发方面，正如你所预料的，Rockstar创始人兼执行制作人Sam Houser位列制作人员名单之首，与他一同列出的还有发行主管Jennifer Kolbe，以及工作室联合负责人Rob Nelson和Aaron Garbut。如果你在寻找他们，去年在有争议的情况下被Rockstar解雇的34名员工都获得了署名。

paragraphs.en: There's no sign of Sam Houser's brother and Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser, who left Rockstar in 2020 — despite GTA 6's early development already being underway by this point. GTA 6 is the franchise's first major 3D release not to include his name in the credits. (And no, there's no sign of Leslie Benzies' name either, though he departed several years prior, back in 2016.)
paragraphs.cn: 名单上没有Sam Houser的兄弟、Rockstar联合创始人Dan Houser的名字。他于2020年离开Rockstar，尽管《GTA6》的早期开发工作在当时已经展开。《GTA6》是该系列首部未在制作人员名单中列出他名字的主要3D作品。（没错，名单上也没有Leslie Benzies的名字，不过他早在几年前的2016年就已离开。）

paragraphs.en: Clearly, GTA 6 was an enormous development effort across Rockstar Games and its parent company, Take-Two, which has yet to announce early sales numbers for the game. We don't know how much GTA 6 cost to make, but we're looking at the most expensive video game ever made, with a budget potentially over the $1 billion mark. Based on preorder estimates, Take-Two will have made its money back on preorders alone.
paragraphs.cn: 显然，《GTA6》是Rockstar及其母公司Take-Two投入巨大精力开发的作品，后者尚未公布游戏的早期销量数据。我们不知道《GTA6》的制作成本是多少，但我们眼前的是有史以来制作成本最高的电子游戏，其预算可能超过10亿美元。根据预购量估算，Take-Two光靠预购就将收回成本。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？就在IGN查看《GTA6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者通过第一章指南与提示及第二章指南与提示了解前几章的全部细节。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现的内容和可以做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
